Tern Queue latency worksheet
Record: doc-005
Date: 2025-04-16
Collection: Fictional queue-study archive

Normal-operation measurements used one client and batches of 100 labels, with no induced restarts. There were 2,400 unique labels in each configuration.

Retained journal baseline: median 82 ms, p95 118 ms.
Retry-gate configuration: median 65 ms, p95 104 ms.

The charter's 120 ms p95 threshold is met for this workload. The worksheet contains no multi-client or power-interruption latency result. Counter definitions and exclusions are recorded in [[doc-009]]. Its use in the pilot decision is recorded in [[doc-004]].
